title: Twist E24: Base-field Jacobian arithmetic and independent arbitrary-class replay
status_note: Proposed E24; not started. Balanced Fp arithmetic, independent arbitrary-class checker and complete non-split factorization support are missing. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Balanced Fp arithmetic, independent arbitrary-class checker and complete non-split factorization support are missing.
question: How much of the present cover cost comes from the Fp6 chart, and do arbitrary-class maps replay in an independent same-field representation?
decision_value: A verified base-field stage improvement enables a correctly priced cover pipeline comparison. Missing independent arithmetic or exceptional charts leaves transfer validation partial. No destination decomposition solver is supplied merely by changing charts.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, 3,600 seconds per fixture with per-class checkpoints. Preserve partial exhaustive progress and failures; do not replace the required whole smallest population with samples. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.
